No. 3 of 2026
AN ACT to amend the Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act,
Cap. 8.01 and for related matters.
[ 19th February, 2026 ]
BE IT ENACTED by the King’s Most Excellent Majesty, by
and with the advice and consent of the House of Assembly and Senate
of Saint Lucia, and by the authority of the same, as follows:

20
No. 3 ] Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic (Amendment) Act [ 2026
Short title
1. This Act may be cited as the Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic
(Amendment) Act, 2026.
Amendment of section 28
2. Section 28 of the Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic Act, Cap.
8.01 is amended —
(a) in subsection (8) by —
(i) deleting the full stop at the end of paragraph (d) and
substituting a semi-colon,
(ii) inserting immediately after paragraph (d) the following
new paragraph (e) —
“(e)the holder is a police officer employed with the
Royal Saint Lucia Police Force and is the driver
of a motor vehicle used by the Royal Saint Lucia
Police Force.”;
(b) deleting subsection (9) and substituting the following —
“(9) An application under subsection (8) must contain —
(a) in the case of subsection (8)(a), a copy of the
passport of the holder showing proof that the
holder was not admitted to Saint Lucia during the
period for which an exemption is being requested;
(b) in the case of subsection (8)(d), a letter from
a registered medical practitioner certifying the
period and nature of the illness;

21
No. 3 ] Motor Vehicles and Road Traffic (Amendment) Act [ 2026
(c) in the case of subsection (8)(e), evidence that the
police officer is employed with the Royal Saint
Lucia Police Force and is a driver of a motor
vehicle used by the Royal Saint Lucia Police
Force.”.
Passed in the House of Assembly this 3rd day of February, 2026.
CLAUDIUS J. FRANCIS,
Speaker of the House of Assembly.
Passed in the Senate this 10th day of February, 2026.
ALVINA REYNOLDS,
President of the Senate.
